build: cargo test --release; default thin LTO, one codegen unit

method.redis: redis:7-alpine in a separate test container
method.account_read: Direct IngressProxy::account_field nonce call; includes the Redis or HTTP executor query, excludes client-to-ingress HTTP
method.admission: Serial submit_validated with 400 unique signed transactions per repeat; every one must reach a shard queue; receipt execution is mocked
method.stale_state: Redis row and live head at position 10, unrelated local frame at 100, max_stale_txs=8; executor answers nonce 5 while Redis holds nonce 3
method.percentiles: Merge sorted per-round nanosecond samples; select index floor(n * percentile / 100)
method.scope: A microbenchmark on a shared host. These measurements do not establish maximum chain throughput or production client latency. Runtime variation prevents treating lower after numbers as a speedup. Full cluster workload comparison remains required.

reproduce: KARDAMOM_PROFILE_LABEL=label cargo test --release -p kardamom-ingress --features docker-e2e,test-support --test account_cache_redis_test --locked -- --ignored --exact profile::profile_account_cache_paths --nocapture
